quest.title: Home Lies Over the Ocean
quest.description: Atsuko, who is living in Liyue, seems to have something on her mind...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I wonder how mom is doing, and dad as well...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Oh? Traveler? What are you doing here? I remember you asked me how to go to Inazuma last time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've been to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: You did go. And you managed to come back...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: You live up to your reputation as a warrior. Your abilities are far beyond those of ordinary folks like me.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Oh right! If you don't mind, can you do me a favor?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: When I left Inazuma, I left without saying goodbye.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Ever since I was little, I've longed for the world outside of Inazuma. I liked to travel and I disliked being controlled by my parents.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: After they issued the Vision Hunt Decree, the atmosphere in Inazuma has become increasingly suffocating. That's why I decided to leave my hometown.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: When I came to Liyue, although I managed to find a way to survive. I couldn't find a reliable person to send a message to my family back home.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Can I ask you for a favor to help deliver a letter to my parents?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Thank you! Well, I'll leave the letter to you.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: By the way, my father's name is "Yoh," and my mother's name is "Michiru." I'll mark the address on the map for you.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: After leaving my hometown, I've experienced a lot. Now I know that if I want to become an independent and strong woman, I can't just rely on my parents like before.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I've decided that I won't go back to my hometown in the near future. If I encounter any difficulties outside, I will face them by myself.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I think my parents will be proud of me if I can do that.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I also wrote about my determination in the letter, so please take it to my parents.

choices.text: Do you want to go back and have a look?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Although I miss my parents, if I go back now, I'm afraid I won't be able to leave anymore.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I don't have the ability to come and go freely like you. No matter what, I wouldn't dare to go back.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I'll be happy if you can take this letter to Inazuma. I really wouldn't ask for anything more.

talks.objective: Give the letter to Michiru and Yoh

dialogues.speaker: Michiru
dialogues.text: How many dishes should we make for lunch tomorrow?

dialogues.speaker: Yoh
dialogues.text: Our kids can eat a lot these days. Let's just cook more.

dialogues.speaker: Yoh
dialogues.text: Hmm? Who might you be...

choices.text: May I ask if this is Atsuko's house?

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Yes, we are. What can I do for you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Atsuko asked me to bring you this letter.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: Letter? Why would that child suddenly want to write a letter to us?

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: The letter is quite long... I mean, she's back at home already, so if she wants to say something, she should just say it to us directly.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: ...Traveler, it sounds like you're surprised? It's true that Atsuko was traveling abroad before, but she's come back now.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: Why does she want to send a letter to us when she's already back home with us? Did you mistake us for someone else?

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Wait a minute, dear. I had a brief scan of the letter. The handwriting and the way it's written, it's definitely from our daughter.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: The letter also says that she doesn't plan to come back in the near future, and tells us to take care of ourselves.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: What does this all mean? Could it be that she came back on her own while getting this Traveler to deliver this letter to us?

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: I feel there might be a misunderstanding. After that child comes home, we'll ask her.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Unfortunately, Atsuko had matters to attend to today. After she's back, we'll ask her for clarification.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: If it's okay with you, please find us tomorrow evening. We'll get that child to explain everything to you.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: That child said she's busy working. After breakfast, she left the house in a hurry.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: Yeah, every day, she leaves early and comes back late. We only get to see her in the evening, so we aren't sure what she's really up to.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Anyway, please come over tomorrow evening. If that child has done something wrong, we'll make sure she apologizes to you in person.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: We're really sorry that you had to travel such a long way.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: That Atsuko, if only she was more well behaved...

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: That child said she's busy working. She leaves the house for the entire day after breakfast.

choices.text: Would you happen to be Atsuko's parents?

dialogues.speaker: Yoh
dialogues.text: Why is our daughter back before the date of signature on this letter?

dialogues.speaker: Michiru
dialogues.text: Let's not overthink things. It's probably a misunderstanding. It'll be more helpful if you can help me figure out what to make for lunch tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Yoh
dialogues.text: Atsuko hasn't returned yet. Please come back in the evening.

dialogues.speaker: Michiru
dialogues.text: If you wait until the evening, then Atsuko should be back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Atsuko should be back now. Let's knock on the door.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They seem to be talking about something.

dialogues.speaker: Michiru
dialogues.text: That being said, I wonder what happened to the Tanuki that we rescued before.

dialogues.speaker: Yoh
dialogues.text: You're too kind. That Tanuki only had a minor scrape on its leg. If you let it be in the bushes, it would've recovered by itself.

dialogues.speaker: Michiru
dialogues.text: I couldn't help it. It was looking at me with tears in its eyes. It looked very pitiful. My conscience just wouldn't let me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoh
dialogues.text: Forget it. It's never wrong to do good deeds. It's just that it ate a bit too much, nearly as much as me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Knocking on the door

dialogues.speaker: Yoh
dialogues.text: Who is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm the Traveler that came here before.

dialogues.speaker: Yoh
dialogues.text: Ahh, I remember you. Please wait here.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: He—Hello! I'm Atsuko, first... no... nice to see you again!

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Sorry, I was homesick. After I gave you the letter, I changed my mind and took a ship back to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Ahaha... Sorry for not clarifying things before, and making you travel so far.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you return to Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: ...Ah, I had my ways, haha. You don't have to worry about that.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Um, I've prepared the payment for you. Please take it. Thanks for your help. Hurry... uh, hurry up and go about the rest of your day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How come the things that Atsuko are telling us now are different from what it was before? If returning to Inazuma was so easy, why did you ask us for help in the first place?

choices.text: What happened to your business in Liyue?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Business? What business? I had a business in Liyue!?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: ...Ah, that kind of stuff is unimportant. Nothing is more important than family. I already entrusted it all to someone else, ah... haha.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hang on! The real Atsuko had trouble finding a job in Liyue, there's no way that she'd suddenly become rich!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who are you?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I—I'm Atsuko, of course! I look like Atsuko and sound like Atsuko. What's there to be suspicious about?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Look here! Stop being so persistent... forget it. I won't talk to you anymore. I've got work tomorrow. I'm heading off now.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: Atsuko! That child... Why did she get angry all of a sudden...

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Sorry about that, Traveler. That child must be too tired from her work.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: But you saw her for yourselves. That's our daughter. That letter... Maybe that child forgot about it.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: But in any case, we'd still like to thank you for the trouble you went through. As for the payment... Would you be able to wait a little longer?

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Nothing of that sort. We can still afford the payment.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: You know how we told you that Atsuko goes to work during the day? The payment that she receives has always been strange.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: She always brings back weird seeds or some wild fruits, but she never brings back Mora.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Even though things like that do have some value, we have to sell them first.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: For a traveler like you, I guess Mora would be more convenient.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Please come here again tomorrow. By then, we should be able to give you the Mora.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Mansion? What? I even had a mansion in Liyue!?

dialogues.speaker: Michiru
dialogues.text: Where did our daughter run off to...

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: Even if she's working the next day, Atsuko usually says something to us before leaving. But today, she left without saying anything.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: After you left yesterday, Atsuko said she was tired and went straight to her room to sleep.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: By the time we got up the next day, she wasn't in bed anymore.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: We tried looking everywhere for her. My husband searched far and wide.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: However, even after half a day, we still couldn't find any traces of our daughter.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: *sigh* Did that child go off on another journey again? What a troublesome child...

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Calm down, dear. I'll look for her again. Please sweep Atsuko's room first.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: After that child left, she didn't close the window properly. A lot of leaves blew into the room.

response.speaker: Yoh
response.text: Before I forget. Here's the payment. Please take it.

response.speaker: Michiru
response.text: *sigh* That child, Atsuko... Where is she off to this time...

choices.text: Has Atsuko gone off to work again?

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I wonder how mom is doing, and dad as well...
